newsitem.title: USA: Borden Foods Corp recalls Mac & Cheese dinners.
newsitem.headline: Borden Foods Corp recalls Mac & Cheese dinners.

text.p: Borden Foods Corp said Friday it is advising consumers not to consume Creamette Mac & Cheese dinners in the 7.25 ounce box with code P6165B1N or P6165C1N impressed in the bottom panel of the box.
The company said it is acting as a precautionary measure following a few consumer reports of small metallic shavings found in the product.
No reports of consumer injury have been received by Borden Foods, and no other production codes are involved, the company said.

The advisory covers consumers in 19 states: Colorado, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Kentucky, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, Nebraska, Ohio, New Mexico, North Dakota, Pennsylvania, South Dakota, Utah, West Virginia, Wisconsin and Wyoming.
Also as a precautionary measure, Borden has taken steps to remove all product with the indicated codes that may be on store shelves or in distribution centers, it said.
